findings.issue: The summary presents `--extend=N` as adding N passes to any finished run, with no fan-out restriction. Both workflows refuse the flag when the config carries fan-out executors: `step_reject_extend_with_fanout` in deep-research.yaml (331-340) and deep-review.yaml (308-317) halts with a usage error before any lineage spawns, and both presentation contracts and both packet catalogs state "refused with fan-out". The paragraph immediately after this one advertises fan-out runs, so the unconditional wording is wrong for them.

evidence.cmd: rg -n "Refuse --extend on a fan-out|extend-with-fanout|refused with fan-out" .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research-presentation.txt .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review-presentation.txt
evidence.out:
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review-presentation.txt:76:| `extend` | N | flag `--extend=N` (positive integer); sets `lineage_mode=completed-continue` on a completed run; refused with fan-out | none | N |
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research-presentation.txt:75:| `extend` | N | flag `--extend=N` (positive integer); sets `lineage_mode=completed-continue` on a completed run; refused with fan-out | none | N |
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml:331:    description: "Refuse --extend on a fan-out config before any lineage spawns"
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml:340:    message: "Usage error (extend-with-fanout): --extend extends a single-executor research run only. This config has fanout executors, so nothing was spawned and the run is unchanged."
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml:308:    description: "Refuse --extend on a fan-out config before any lineage spawns"
.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml:317:    message: "Usage error (extend-with-fanout): --extend extends a single-executor review run only. This config has fanout executors, so nothing was spawned and the run is unchanged."

fix.old: `--extend=N` adds N passes to a finished run in the same session.
fix.new: `--extend=N` adds N passes to a finished single-executor run in the same session.

findings.issue: The entry says only the expansive value reaches the runtime. The explicit default reaches it too: both workflows write `antiConvergence.depthMode: "{depth_mode}"` into the config and pass `--depth-mode "{depth_mode}"` to convergence.cjs and fanout-run.cjs, and the default-identity golden test carries a variant named "explicit --depth-mode=default" with `depthMode: 'default'` in both the config and the convergence args. Only the behavior change is gated on `expansive` (convergence.cjs:1192, reduce-state.cjs:2176).

evidence.out:

.skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/tests/unit/research-depth-mode-golden.vitest.ts:75:      antiConvergence: { convergenceMode: 'default', depthMode: 'default' },
